proposed_decision.rule: Adopt the 464 explicit A1 semantic slots as the concept inventory required to complement the 36 already credited A1 seeds and reach the 500-unit A1 target. The Portuguese and English labels define concept references only; they do not select or imply HNK forms.

governance_decisions.proposal: Approve semantic-slot-first authoring: no HNK form, G-ID sequence, phonology or morphology is assigned merely from PT/EN glosses or reference-language similarity.
Preserve seven existing HOLD-seed links as reservations/review warnings only: ON, KUON, MAMA, PAPA, TA, VAME and VAMATAYA. No HOLD seed is resolved, credited or assigned to a slot by this gate.
Before any new form is selected for a slot carrying a HOLD-seed link, resolve or explicitly supersede that seed in a separate lexical-authority gate to avoid duplicate concepts.

This gate creates zero new HNK words, zero new G-ID forms, zero language-authority promotions, zero grammar rules and zero curriculum/runtime changes. After approval, prepare the A1 lexeme-authoring strategy and batching contract before form generation.

approval_rule: A future SIGA may approve only DEC-HNK3000-A1-SLOTS-001 through DEC-HNK3000-A1-SLOTS-006 if this gate remains materially unchanged. The same SIGA must not generate any HNK form, resolve HOLD seeds, approve B16 or alter L03 curriculum/runtime.
